question: What arises for one who knows the hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature leads to all-knowingness.
The verse states arising of all-knowingness.
inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: Gender of taṃ is contextually ambiguous.
gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ may function as an accusative object or modifier.
plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
